name: Fine-tuning graders — score_model judge
summary: POST /v1/fine_tuning/alpha/graders/validate and /run take a nested `grader.model` (a judge LLM, e.g. `o4-mini-2025-04-16`) used during RFT training and grader validation.
description: Reinforcement fine-tuning graders can include a `score_model` grader whose `grader.model` names the judge LLM used to score training outputs. That nested judge slot would need to accept `{connection}/{deployment}` for BYOM-routed grading inside the fine-tuning surface.
notes:
Not yet probed against Foundry with a captured server response. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/graders. See `test.py` for the `score_model` grader wiring.

Fine-tuning itself is winding down per OpenAI, and the base model on `POST /v1/fine_tuning/jobs` remains tracked in `byom-incompatible-endpoints`.
